cases.explain: «третий раз» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: He said to them the third time, “Why? What evil has this man done? I have found no capital crime in him. I will therefore chastise him and release him.”

cases.sentence: Было около ___ дня , и по всей земле стало темно, и это продолжалось до часа девятого .
cases.explain: «шестого часа» — after the preposition «около», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: It was now about the sixth hour, and darkness came over the whole land until the ninth hour.

cases.sentence: Будучи членом Совета, 51 он, однако, не был согласен с решением и делом ___.
cases.explain: «иудейских вождей» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Behold, a man named Joseph, who was a member of the council, a good and righteous man

cases.explain: «душистые мази» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: They returned and prepared spices and ointments. On the Sabbath they rested according to the commandment.
